_notes: The Sunday homily as a lever (playtesting): the man chooses what he preaches on this month and the weekly effects run while it stands. Change it at most once every four weeks. Effects are per week; the reasons show on the Parish sheet as 'the homily on ...'.

topics.label: The readings
topics.blurb: Sunday's Gospel, and what it asks. The safest thing and the hardest to do well; a parish that hears only this either loves you or says you never say anything.

topics.label: The parish's own trouble
topics.blurb: The school, the debt, the empty pews, the thing everyone knows and nobody says from the pulpit. The people who feel named will mind; the ones who were waiting for someone to say it will stay.

topics.label: The week's news, through the Gospel
topics.blurb: Immigration, the war, the election, the strike. It is what a homily was for and what a chancery dreads. Where you land on it moves the wings; that you spoke at all moves the record.

topics.label: The bishop's letter
topics.blurb: Read it, and preach it: the appeal, the pastoral letter, the diocesan plan. The chancery notices who does and the people notice who reads it as if he believed it.

topics.label: The money
topics.blurb: The collection, the campaign, the roof. Every pastor has to and every vicar is told to. The plate rises for a month and the people start to hear it coming.

topics.label: Vocations
topics.blurb: Priesthood and religious life, said plainly to the boys in the back and the mothers who will not look at you. A bishop with a seminary to fill remembers who preached it.
